notes.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH released today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909400/FINAL_FANTASY_VII_REBIRTH/

The FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE project brings FINAL FANTASY VII, the legendary RPG that enthralled the world, back to life using the latest technology.  

The first game in the series, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE was released in 2020 and received critical acclaim across the world, achieving global sales of over 7,000,000 copies (as of May 2023).

Now, the core of the FINAL FANTASY VII story returns with the second game in the trilogy: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH! 

Early purchase sale running until 05/02/2025!
Twin pack also available for 30% off! 
Why not take this chance to own both FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE and FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH for around the cost of just a single game?!

[h3]We are also running a Twitch Drops campaign offering amazing in-game items![/h3]
Watch the FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH live broadcast on Twitch to obtain the in-game items Kupo Charm and Survival Set!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343568/411582687ec0189f1052af3c9d0588597a6d7e28.png[/img]
Kupo Charm
An accessory that increases the amount of crafting materials extracted by a set rate. 

Survival Set
A pack containing useful items such as potions and ethers that will aid you on your adventure. 

[h3]■Campaign period[/h3]
From 14:00 GMT on Thursday 23/01/2025 until 17:59 GMT on Wednesday 05/02/2025

[h3]■Campaign rewards[/h3]
Kupo Charm accessory and Survival Set.
You can earn the Kupo Charm and Survival Set to use in the FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH game by watching 30 minutes or more of the relevant live broadcast on Twitch during the campaign period.

[h3]■How to participate in the campaign[/h3]
　➡　Log in to your Twitch account (Requires a Twitch account)

　➡　Watch the relevant FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH live broadcast that is part of the Twitch Drops campaign for 30 minutes or more.
*You can check which broadcast is the one participating in the campaign by navigating to the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/DROPS/campaigns]Drops & Rewards[/url] section of Twitch and selecting “FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH”, then “Open Participating Live Channels”.

　➡　After watching the broadcast for 30 minutes or more, push the “Claim now” button in the FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH section of the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/DROPS/inventory]Twitch Drops inventory page[/url] to visit the [url=https://ffvii-rebirth.twitch.rewards.square-enix.com]Square Enix Twitch Rewards page[/url] and push the “Obtain product code” button to acquire a Steam product code.

*Please see the [url=https://ffvii-rebirth.twitch.rewards.square-enix.com]Square Enix Twitch Rewards page[/url] for full details.

notes.title: Be ready for FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH on PC
notes.content:
Just announced! 
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH is set for a Steam launch on January 23, 2025.

[previewyoutube=9608h47LoWg;full][/previewyoutube]

This version introduces new features and customizations to take full advantage of the PC platform: 

[h3]LIGHTING[/h3]
Lighting has been adjusted, and the game's overall rendering of light is significantly improved. The updated areas and cutscenes present with even greater beauty and clarity than before.

[h3]PC SPECS[/h3]
The PC version of FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH features three default graphics presets to make it even easier for you to jump in and start playing at a level that suits your own PC: High, Medium and Low. We have optimised these presets to allow as many people to enjoy the game as possible on a wide variety of setups.
Gameplay offers an experience that will feel new, including high frame rates of up to 120 FPS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155195/a7bbf3b8b95c15459026714ba9d0c96c03044d1e.jpg[/img]
[h3]FRAMERATE AND RESOLUTION[/h3]
NVIDIA DLSS support means that frame rates can be enhanced and image quality upscaled. There is now also support for variable refresh rate (VRR).

[h3]TEXTURES[/h3]
The Level of Detail (LoD) for background models and MIP maps for background textures can both be freely configured in the options settings.
With this background polygon density and texture density can be set higher than was previously possible, allowing for gameplay with higher-quality graphics.

[h3]CONTROLLER INPUT SUPPORT[/h3]
Connecting a DualSense® controller with a PC allows players to use the same controls as the PS5 version.
Keyboard and mouse support has also been added, alongside the option to freely customize the controls between world exploration and combat or mini-games.

[h3]STEAM DECK[/h3]
We are also working diligently on optimisations to make sure that the Steam version is playable on Steam Deck as well.

Pre-purchase to receive a 30% Early Bird Discount* and three digital bonus items**: 'Moogle Trio' summoning materia, Midgar Bangle Mk. II Armor, Shinra bangle Mk. II.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909400/

* Offer applies to select versions of the game. Up to 30% off digital pre-orders until 5 February 2025. Certain restrictions may apply.
** These bonus items can be obtained by pre-purchasing the game before 13:59 on Thursday 23/01/2025 (GMT).
** Digital content items may be put on sale separately at a later date.

For the latest updates on FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH, make sure you follow us on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY XVI NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515020/FINAL_FANTASY_XVI/

An epic dark fantasy where fates are decided by mighty Eikons and the Dominants who wield them. This is the tale of Clive Rosfield, a tragic warrior who swears revenge on the Dark Eikon Ifrit, a mysterious entity that leaves naught but calamity in its wake.

[b]■Content included with this product[/b]
[list]
[*]  FINAL FANTASY XVI Base Game
[*]  “Onion Sword” weapon (Available for redemption from the System tab in the Main Menu upon reaching the main scenario quest "A Chance Encounter.")
[/list]
[b]■Early purchase bonuses:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155195/364287c8359250ae1a2d581fd0550c41ec24f0e3.png[/img]
[list]
[*]  Accessory: "Cait Sith's Charm"
[*]  Valuable item: "Sixteen Bells Orchestrion Roll"
[*]  Weapon "Brave Blade" 
[/list]
*These items can be acquired by customers who pre-order or purchase the game between 4:00 pm UTC on 19/08/2024 and 3:00 pm UTC on 17/10/2024 (The specific time that the items become unavailable is subject to change).
*In-game items can be claimed from the System tab in the main menu. The ability to claim items is unlocked after approximately two hours of play.
*An internet connection is required to claim in-game items.
*These in-game items may be put on sale or distributed via another method from a future date.



[h3]Demo Available Now![/h3]
[b]■ FINAL FANTASY XVI DEMO[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155195/994827a7183b12ede2418c7263dc1fd44cf1fab2.jpg[/img]

Play the opening section of FINAL FANTASY XVI. Save data can be carried over to the full version of the game.
After completing the opening section of the story, players can enjoy FINAL FANTASY XVI’s amazing action gameplay in the “Eikonic Challenge” mode made specially for this demo.

*Some content in this demo may vary from the final game.
*It is not possible to save or load game data for the Eikonic Challenge mode. Data from this mode cannot be carried over to the release version of the game.

notes.title: Version 1.002 Patch
notes.content:
FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE has been updated to Version 1.002 on all platforms.

Please see the details below.

-The game now supports DualSense Edge™ wireless controllers and Bluetooth® connectivity for all compatible controllers, excluding certain vibration-related features.
-The issue for certain multiple-monitor configurations where the game's startup screen would not appear on the main display has been rectified.

Please note that, if you select "DualSense Edge Wireless Controller" or "Wireless Controller" on the "Controller Settings" submenu under "Options," you will not be able to take advantage of the DualSense Edge™ controller's added features such as vibration functionality. If you wish to use such features, please select "XInput Controller" instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536301/0c5b21767f6a8188b6fca08429318c2ee62eacaf.png[/img]

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM
notes.content:
This game contains  FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE, a new episode called FF7R EPISODE INTERmission that features Yuffie as the main character, and Photo Mode, which allows you to take pictures of memorable moments.

* This game is a remake of FINAL FANTASY VII, first released in 1997.
The first title in a multi-part series, it is based on the story from the original game, up to the escape from Midgar, adding in new  elements.
